referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Describes the use of a desktop computer with a CRT monitor in the standby/sleep mode. Calculated per 1 hour of computer use. Computer life span assumed to be 4 years, for the CRT monitor 6 years. Standby/sleep mode 2 hours a day (office use), 240 days a year. UCTE production mix applied for electricity consumption (low voltage).
